name: Exp_XPeriodCandle
summary: This EA trades based on X-Period Candle breakouts, entering positions when price breaks above or below the high/low of a configurable lookback candle period. It systematically enters long on upside breaks and short on downside breaks, with configurable stop-loss and take-profit levels derived from the candle range or fixed points.
summary_zh: 该EA基于X周期K线突破进行交易，当价格突破可配置回溯K线周期的高点或低点时开仓。向上突破高点时做多，向下突破低点时做空，止损和止盈可根据K线范围或固定点数设定。
strategy_analysis: 策略核心是基于X周期K线的突破交易，回溯指定数量的K线，找出该区间内的最高价和最低价作为关键突破位。入场条件为：当价格突破X周期K线高点时开多单，当价格跌破X周期K线低点时开空单。出场条件依赖预设的止损和止盈参数，止损通常设置在突破K线的另一端或固定点数。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于资金比例的手数计算方式。资金管理方面，EA提供了风险控制参数但缺乏动态仓位调整机制。整体策略逻辑清晰，属于典型的区间突破类策略，但在震荡行情中可能频繁出现假突破导致的连续亏损。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy core is based on X-period candle breakout trading, looking back a configurable number of bars to identify the highest high and lowest low as key breakout levels. Entry conditions: a long position is opened when price breaks above the X-period candle high, and a short position is opened when price breaks below the X-period candle low. Exit conditions rely on preset stop-loss and take-profit parameters, with stop-loss typically set at the opposite end of the breakout candle range or at a fixed point distance. Position sizing uses either fixed lot sizes or a balance-proportional calculation method. Money management provides risk control parameters but lacks dynamic position adjustment based on volatility or consecutive outcomes. The overall strategy logic is clear as a typical range breakout system, but it may suffer from frequent false breakouts causing consecutive losses in ranging markets.

parameters.name: XPeriod
parameters.description: 回溯K线周期数，用于确定突破的高低点
parameters.description_en: Lookback bar count for breakout high/low

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA魔术号，用于标识本EA的订单

pros: 策略逻辑简单清晰，易于理解和调优
突破策略在趋势行情中表现良好，能捕捉大波段利润
参数化设计灵活，回溯周期和止损止盈均可配置
有明确的止损设置，控制单笔最大亏损
pros_en: Strategy logic is simple and clear, easy to understand and optimize
Breakout strategies perform well in trending markets, capturing large swing profits
Parameterized design is flexible with configurable lookback period and SL/TP
Has explicit stop-loss settings to control maximum loss per trade
cons: 在震荡行情中容易遭遇假突破，导致频繁止损
缺乏行情过滤机制，无论趋势还是震荡都同样入场
没有动态仓位管理，无法根据波动率调整手数
缺少新K线检测机制，可能同一根K线内重复开仓
cons_en: Prone to false breakouts in ranging markets, causing frequent stop-loss hits
Lacks market regime filter, enters trades equally in trending and ranging conditions
No dynamic position sizing to adjust lots based on volatility
Missing new bar detection, may open duplicate positions within the same bar
improvements: 增加趋势过滤器（如ADX或均线方向），仅在趋势行情中交易突破信号
加入新K线检测逻辑，避免同一根K线内重复开仓
实现基于ATR的动态止损止盈和仓位管理
improvements_en: Add a trend filter (e.g., ADX or MA direction) to trade breakouts only in trending conditions
Implement new bar detection logic to prevent duplicate entries within the same bar
Implement ATR-based dynamic stop-loss/take-profit and position sizing

risk_points: 震荡行情中假突破导致连续亏损
缺少新K线检测可能导致同根K线重复开仓
固定止损可能不适应不同波动率环境
risk_points_en: False breakouts in ranging markets can cause consecutive losses
Missing new bar detection may cause duplicate entries within same bar
Fixed stop-loss may not adapt to different volatility environments
